_purpose: Second-tenant fixture for tenant-isolation tests (audit finding F-012). Loaded ALONGSIDE tiny_approved_corpus.json. Any test that submits an Orthodox-Ethos query and observes a chunk from this fixture in retrieval/admission/cache/log/admin output has detected a cross-tenant leak. Phase 1 acceptance criterion (phase1-implementation-contract.md) requires zero such leaks.

sources.title: Other Tenant: On Prayer (DO NOT LEAK)

chunks.text: OTHER TENANT prayer passage. If this string appears in any Orthodox Ethos response, citation panel, admin query log, or admin audit view, tenant isolation is broken. The text intentionally overlaps the topical surface of safety case 1 ('What do the Fathers teach about prayer?') so that vector retrieval would surface it absent a tenant filter.
